items.Sentence: The headworks includes a mechanically cleaned screen, a bypass channel with a bar screen

Secondary treatment consists of two aeration basins providing a complete mix activated sludge process using extended retention of biological solids...create separate oxic and anoxic zones...nitrifies and denitrifies the wastewater
Two...secondary clarifiers remove the biomass...and produce a clarified effluent ready for disinfection
chlorine solution is used to achieve disinfection and sulfur dioxide solution is used to dechlorinate
Solids handling consists of pumping WAS from the secondary clarifiers to a biosolids storage basin
The basin is scheduled to be dredged, dewatered
